source.title: Sarkar, Ghosh, Chatterjee: Design of a 2 mW Power, 112 dB Gain-Boosted, Folded Cascode Amplifier in 0.18 um Process (IEEE ISIE 2021)
source.figure: Fig. 1 (p. 1, main PMOS-input folded cascode with CMFB and the N-input / P-input auxiliary amplifiers), Fig. 3 (P-input auxiliary), Fig. 5 (N-input auxiliary)
source.inputs: source/ (paper PDF, Paper5_Metrics.xlsx, Paper5_Corners.xlsx, Fig. 5 PNG; see source/ORIGIN.txt)
modifications: None. final.scs is the dataset team's 2026-10-28 re-export (DAC-dataset commit 03466f5, 'Fixed issue'); it holds the complete circuit: the main amplifier (Mp1-Mp13, Mn1-Mn4, Mn9, Mn10 incl. the CMFB), the N-input auxiliary amplifier (N_*) and the P-input auxiliary amplifier (P_*); the earlier export (2026-10-24) held only an auxiliary amplifier (kept in _superseded/2026-10-28/). Every device size equals the paper's figure label (onboarding_status.yaml netlist_check_2026_10_28).

Vb1.provenance: curator choice (the paper prints no bias values: only unvalued branch currents I1/I2/I3 and ideal 'Vb' labels in Figs. 1, 3, 5): main PMOS gate bias (gates of Mp1/Mp2/Mp5/Mp6/Mp13) generated by a current-fed diode-connected pmos1 18/0.18 um (testbench element, as a mirror bias generator: the bias voltage tracks process and temperature like the paper's corner results imply); the reference current is the sizing variable, initial value found by simulation so that the paper-size amplifier is biased with every device saturated and draws about the paper's 2.08 mW

N_VB1.provenance: curator choice (the paper prints no bias values: only unvalued branch currents I1/I2/I3 and ideal 'Vb' labels in Figs. 1, 3, 5): N-aux PMOS top sources generated by a current-fed diode-connected pmos1 1.8/1 um (testbench element, as a mirror bias generator: the bias voltage tracks process and temperature like the paper's corner results imply); the reference current is the sizing variable, initial value found by simulation so that the paper-size amplifier is biased with every device saturated and draws about the paper's 2.08 mW

op_check.note: N_Mn5/N_Mn6 (N-aux) and P_Mp7/P_Mp8 (P-aux) are the auxiliary amplifiers' CMFB summing devices (Figs. 3 and 5): their gates are the aux outputs and they act as variable (triode / edge) resistors in the tail path by design.

known_issues: The paper prints no bias values and no load capacitance: nine bias reference currents are curator-chosen sizing variables and CL is a curator choice (onboarding_status.yaml).
